vagrant.text: A hollow, ghostly gust, then a lone violin phrase (a solo stem from the Ember score, standing in for his fiddle).

druskenvald.text: About eight seconds of soft, scratchy swing, like an old 78 playing in the lounge car, fading out with the banner. I generated it for this page (clarinet, walking bass, rhythm guitar, brushes and a quiet sax section, played through a phonograph filter with hiss and crackle).

vessla.text: A dark whoosh, then tiny clawed feet skittering (Ember's spider scuttling, the closest thing to ferret feet in your library).

crooked.text: A dark whoosh, then rain heard from indoors, with thunder rolling in just after the flash (Michael Ghelfi, vol. 7).

jericho.text: A hollow, ghostly gust, across the field, then a quiet field with a run of crow caws (Monument Studios, Forestscapes).

harvest.text: A burst of wings, then a murder of crows cawing (Abomination Vaults).

abbot.text: A dark whoosh, then a low, rough monks' chant (Dark Fantasy Studio, Monk).

sinner.text: A dark whoosh, then night on the swamp: frogs, insects and water (Abomination Vaults).

widow.text: A hollow, ghostly gust, then faint sobbing over a low drone (Abomination Vaults, weeping ghost).

blight.text: A hollow, ghostly gust, then long, low, guttural bellows (Ember, strange beast).

reaper.text: A hollow, ghostly gust, then rattling chains and a rising wail (Punks in a Powderkeg).

fools.text: A dark whoosh, then a music box winding down as its pitch sags (Dark Fantasy Studio, Music box).

wicker.text: A dark whoosh, then a deep, droning chant (Dark Fantasy Studio, Dissonant vocals).

horned.text: A hollow gust and the Crooked Tree's roots creaking; at the change Phillip's scream breaks into the beast's bellow, then heavy wing beats (Dark Fantasy Studio, Agony; Ember; Noise Alchemy).

queen.text: A hollow, ghostly gust, then a deep trunk creaking and straining (Ember; the Oak of Many Faces already uses it).

abbottf.text: A dark whoosh and the monks' chant; as he changes, heavy wing beats (Noise Alchemy, dragon wings), then a low growl under the chant (Monsters and Beasts).

reapertf.text: A hollow gust; as he turns, one deep bell stroke (Dark Fantasy Studio, Old Clock), then rattling chains and a rising wail (Punks in a Powderkeg).

trainhopper.text: A hollow gust, a low ghostly drone, then a breathy hiss (Dark Fantasy Studio, Ghostly).

mayor.text: A hand bell rung once over the festival crowd (Dark Fantasy Studio bell; Ember crowd).

stonoga.text: A dark whoosh, skittering legs (Ember) and a croaking rasp (Dark Fantasy Studio, Witch).

hugo.text: A dark whoosh, a heavy sub-bass thud, then a gravelly growl (Dark Fantasy Studio, Abyss).

worm.text: A deep swell from below as it rises, then the book's piercing, alien shriek (Dark Fantasy Studio: Abyss, Dragon, Alien voices).

coven.text: A dark whoosh, teeming vermin, a hag's triumphant cackle and a rattling rasp (Ember; Dark Fantasy Studio).

golubtf.text: The post office bell for Theodora; at the change, a burst of wings and a hag's cackle, then a croak (Dark Fantasy Studio; Ember).

jaeger.text: The monks' chant; at the change, a leathery wing beat and a rough roar (Noise Alchemy; Dark Fantasy Studio).

olaf.text: The monks' chant; at the change, a leathery wing beat and a rough roar (Noise Alchemy; Dark Fantasy Studio).

cromwell.text: The monks' chant; at the change, a leathery wing beat and a rough roar (Noise Alchemy; Dark Fantasy Studio).

gfriend.text: One soft whoosh (Dark Fantasy Studio, Whooshes).

gfoe.text: a colder gust under the whoosh (Dark Fantasy Studio, Creepy wind).

theodora0.text: The post office's bell, and pigeons' wings (Dark Fantasy Studio; Ember).

law.text: A hand bell over the village's murmur (Dark Fantasy Studio; Ember).

rain.text: A soft sustained choir (Female Choir Sustain Morph).

weston.text: A bright ringing chime with a choir behind it (Dark Fantasy Studio, Old Clock).

mori.text: One deep funeral bell (Dark Fantasy Studio, Old Clock).

jenkins.text: A cook fire crackling — they cook for the estate (Mammoth Chronicles).

farmers.text: A cart rolling over grass — William drives the party to Foxwillow (Ember).

renathyrolaf.text: The monks' chant (Dark Fantasy Studio, Monk).

jaeger0.text: A hound baying over the monks' chant (Monument Studios; Dark Fantasy Studio).

cromwell0.text: A low sustained choral chord (Dark Fantasy Studio, Lamentations).

bayou.text: Frogs and birds of the bayou (Ember).

lethica0.text: A slow two-note ticking pulse — her clock (Dark Fantasy Studio, Creepy loops).

yorgrimisolde.text: A cold gust and a low ghostly drone (Dark Fantasy Studio).

finale.text: A dark whoosh, the Horned King's bellow and the Crooked Tree creaking (Dark Fantasy Studio; Ember).

foolstf.text: His music box winding down; a breathy swell as the balloon fills, cut off at the change; then a deep, booming laugh and a long mocking one (Dark Fantasy Studio: Music box, Ghostly, Evil laugh).

crowdemon.text: A burst of wings, three harsh caws, then the demon's own croaking cry (Dark Fantasy Studio, Crow; A House Divided, the Scorncrow).

adelaide.text: Crow caws; at the change a whirl of beating wings as the demon breaks apart, then a young woman's giggle (Dark Fantasy Studio, Crow and Evil laugh; A House Divided, raven transformation).

belkin.text: The sanatorium's low hum, and vials clinking on a tray (Tao & Sound, Horror bundle; Dark Fantasy Studio, Broken glass).

belkintf.text: The sanatorium's hum; at the change a wet squelch, a rush of whispers and a deep gurgle (Tao & Sound; Dark Fantasy Studio: Smashed, Whispers, Alien voices).
